title: Canonical top cohomology comparison for derived module pullback
statement:
Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $n\in\mathbf Z$, and $C\in D(\mathcal O_S)$ [def-pc-derived-category] with $H^i(C)=0$ for $i>n$. Use the canonical truncation $\tau_C:C\to H^n(C)[-n]$ of the standard t-structure [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback], and ordinary module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. For an $\mathcal O_S$-module $M$, let $c_{g,M}:Lg^*(M[0])\to(g^*M)[0]$ be the comparison normalized as the transpose of the ordinary pullback unit [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map]. Then $H^i(Lg^*C)=0$ for $i>n$, $H^0(c_{g,M})$ is an isomorphism, and
$$\kappa_{g,C}:H^n(Lg^*C)\xrightarrow{H^n(Lg^*\tau_C)}H^n(Lg^*(H^n(C)[-n]))\xrightarrow{H^0(c_{g,H^n(C)})}g^*H^n(C)$$
is an isomorphism (the second arrow uses the canonical shift comparison). It is natural for every morphism $u:C\to D$ between objects with cohomology zero above $n$:
$$\kappa_{g,D}H^n(Lg^*u)=g^*H^n(u)\kappa_{g,C}.$$
For every $h:T'\to T$, under the canonical derived composition isomorphism [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] and the ordinary composition isomorphism $c^{\rm ord}_{g,h}:h^*g^*\cong(gh)^*$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-identity-composition],
$$\kappa_{gh,C}=c^{\rm ord}_{g,h,H^n(C)}\,h^*(\kappa_{g,C})\,\kappa_{h,Lg^*C}.$$
No lower cohomological bound, flatness, quasi-coherence, or finite rank is assumed.
